# TallinnJS

> Estonia's largest JavaScript developer community

TallinnJS is a community of 1,200+ JavaScript developers in Tallinn, Estonia. Founded in 2017, we organize free meetups, talks, and workshops for developers of all skill levels.

## Quick Facts

- Location: Tallinn, Estonia
- Founded: 2017
- Members: 1,200+
- Events hosted: 50+
- Speakers featured: 100+

## What We Do

TallinnJS organizes regular meetups featuring:
- Technical talks from industry professionals
- Workshops on modern JavaScript technologies
- Networking opportunities for developers
- Knowledge sharing across all experience levels

## Topics We Cover

- React and Vue.js frameworks
- Node.js and server-side JavaScript
- TypeScript
- Next.js and modern frameworks
- Testing and quality assurance
- Performance optimization
- DevOps and deployment
- GraphQL and REST APIs
- Accessibility
- AI/ML in JavaScript

## How to Join

All TallinnJS events are free and open to everyone. Join us on Meetup to get notified about upcoming events.

## How to Speak

We welcome speakers of all experience levels. Topics related to JavaScript, TypeScript, and web development are welcome. Contact us through Meetup to propose a talk.
